description: Gegenstand dieses Qualifizierungssystems ist die Qualifizierung von Unternehmen für die Erbringung von Leistungen der landschaftspflegerischen Ausführungsplanung im Zusammenhang mit Netzinfrastrukturvorhaben der TransnetBW GmbH. Die Leistungen dienen der ausführungsreifen Konkretisierung der in Genehmigungsunterlagen und behördlichen Entscheidungen festgelegten umweltfachlichen Anforderungen und Maßnahmen sowie der Vorbereitung ihrer späteren Ausführung. Geländebegehungen und ergänzende Erhebungen zur Plausibilisierung und Vervollständigung vorhandener Kartierungen und Datengrundlagen, 3. Konzeption und Konkretisierung der erforderlichen Schutz-, Vermeidungs-, Minderungs-, Ausgleichs- und Ersatzmaßnahmen, 4. Erstellung der ausführungsreifen landschaftspflegerischen Detail- und Ausführungsplanung einschließlich der erforderlichen Berichte, Pläne, Maßnahmenblätter, Bodenschutzpläne, Absteckpläne und Maßnahmenübersichten, 5. Erstellung von Leistungsbeschreibungen und Leistungsverzeichnissen für die Vergabe landschaftspflegerischer Ausführungs-, Pflege- und Entwicklungsleistungen, 6. Erstellung von Leistungsbeschreibungen und Leistungsverzeichnissen für die Vergabe von Bodenschutzmaßnahmen, 7. Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Abstimmungen mit Behörden, Flächeneigentümern und weiteren Projektbeteiligten, 8. title: Pre-Market Engagement: Commercial Filming Services
description: Network Rail currently delivers an end-to-end commercial filming service across a diverse portfolio of railway assets, acting as the primary interface between the rail industry and the screen sector. With the transition to Great British Railways (GBR), Network Rail is exploring future options for delivering these services across a larger estate that will encompass both Network Rail and Train Operating Company assets. Through this market engagement exercise, Network Rail seeks to understand market capability, supplier interest, potential delivery models, opportunities for innovation, and the extent to which external providers could deliver some or all of the service currently carried out in-house. The exercise will help inform future strategy development by assessing market maturity, operational considerations, resource requirements, and the risks and benefits associated with different delivery approaches. Network Rail will be holding supplier engagement sessions in London on 13 and 14 October 2026, providing an opportunity for suppliers to learn more about this forthcoming requirement. Details of how to register can be found in the RFI document, 'Pre-Market Engagement – Commercial Filming Services', which is available under "View Current Opportunities" on the Network Rail eSourcing Portal (Bravo): https://networkrail.bravosolution.co.uk/web/login.html The engagement sessions will be conducted on a one-to-one basis, with each supplier offered a one-hour time slot. Please note that, should it become necessary to reschedule the market engagement sessions, Network Rail will notify all interested suppliers using the email address provided within their RFI response.

title: 2026 Aberdeenshire Dementia Service - Holistic & Community Support
description: Aberdeenshire Council requires the provision of suitable and adequate holistic and community support services to support Service Users within North, South and Central Aberdeenshire. Holistic Support: Information, advice and support will be provided for Service Users throughout Aberdeenshire with signposting to advice and support for their carers offered. Services provided will be flexible and respond to the needs of Service Users. The Service Provider will ensure the safety of the Service User in daily living through continuous prompting and advice. Interaction with appropriate groups and individuals in the community will be encouraged. The Service Provider will endeavour to raise general awareness of dementia amongst professional workers and the general public and promote the development of dementia friendly communities across the region. The Service Provider will establish and maintain clear communication channels with the public, partners, and colleagues, sharing relevant information, and will advertise all events widely throughout Aberdeenshire. Developments in knowledge and learning will be shared with all relevant professionals and service users as appropriate. Community Support: A community development programme will be provided for Service Users. The Service provider will establish, facilitate and support self-help groups in North, South and Central Aberdeenshire.

description: The Neighbourhood Health Optimisation Service (NHOS) is proposed to test a standardised, at-scale primary care led approach to identifying and addressing reversible risk of unplanned admission to hospital, initially in patients aged 65 and over, while their risk is still modifiable.
